verification_scope: Recovered engine source; static packaging and publication have separate GitHub Actions checks.
reference_scope: 753 exposed developer/AI-authored synthetic reports; includes review alerts; not an independent clinical reference.
remaining_gaps: Independent clinician line-by-line review, adjudicated all-eligible held-out patient/site/time/language cohorts, false-closure and workload analysis, prospective silent evaluation and institutional approval remain outstanding. No highest-accuracy or patient-benefit claim is supported.

Multiple lesions sharing one rule and serial same-target plans can still collapse. Site match alone does not establish exact lesion/order/encounter identity. Independent source-bound task references and explicit amendment/withdrawal semantics are needed.

Hard deletions, patient merges/reassignment, tombstones, filter/population changes and authoritative loss-of-evidence reconciliation remain unsupported. Unknown feed content is refused rather than implemented.

External immutable audit anchoring, encrypted storage/backups, institutional tenant/patient authorization, managed credentials, TLS/egress/network controls, restore and incident drills remain operator requirements.

Built-in sync staging fixes local whole-run atomicity. Custom legacy clients and enabled optional second reader retain wide transactions; optimistic staging can reject benign concurrent writes. Hospital-scale memory, lock contention and distributed effects remain unvalidated.

Raw-image/LLM/OCR clinical performance, calibration, all formats/languages, missing acquisition timing, zone/date precision and device-specific policies remain unvalidated. Optional TorchXRayVision weights are unavailable; no live EHR or model inference was tested.

OIDC/SMART discovery/JWKS/connection-check transports do not share every clinical-data budget. Endpoint TLS/DNS policies and previously reported Epic PDF attachment HTTP 400 integration require separate authorized environment testing.
public_site_scope: Static synthetic preview; no hospital backend and no authorization for patient information.
engine_source_commit_scope: Local verified recovery commit; published engine file hashes match this source snapshot.
publication_method: Existing GitHub CI plus an allowlisted static artifact on a dedicated Pages branch. Workflow permission expansion is deferred.
